note: Known fixed fixture map. Marker positions are approximate bearings used only to orient the head for OBSERVE_TARGET (section 11: fixture position may come from a known map; exact pose comes from the visual marker, never from this map). marker_offset_y is the per-station SIGNED installation offset from the table centre to the marker, along the table's long axis under the fixed-orientation assumption; it must match the scene geometry, the vision conversion and the planning collision model. A NEGATIVE offset is supported by the code but was tested for station_c (-0.75, marker at y=-1.25) and OBSERVE_TARGET failed: the marker sits almost at table height on the far side, so the table occludes it from the approach direction. Not an obstacle perception system, and not a claim of arbitrary-rotation support.
